classes.name: address
classes.label: address
classes.definition: index to a location to which communications may be delivered

classes.name: address component
classes.label: address component
classes.definition: aspect of an address

classes.name: addressing scheme
classes.label: addressing scheme
classes.definition: system for allocating addresses to objects

classes.name: conventional street address
classes.label: conventional street address
classes.definition: physical address that identifies a location on a street to which communications may be delivered

classes.name: geographic directional symbol
classes.label: geographic directional symbol
classes.definition: code element that gives directional information for postal delivery

classes.name: physical address
classes.label: physical address
classes.definition: physical address where communications can be addressed, papers served or representatives located for any kind of organization or person

classes.name: physical address identifier
classes.label: physical address identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier for a physical address

classes.name: physical addressing scheme
classes.label: physical addressing scheme
classes.definition: scheme for specifying physical addresses according to a country specific standard

classes.name: post code area
classes.label: post code area
classes.definition: physical area uniquely identified by some postal code

classes.name: post office box
classes.label: post office box
classes.definition: post office box associated with an address

classes.name: post office box address
classes.label: post office box address
classes.definition: physical address used to deliver communications to a designated container at a local post office or the local equivalent for the jurisdiction, where mail is held until the recipient collects it, rather than to a given house, building, or other location

classes.name: post office box designator
classes.label: post office box designator
classes.definition: designator used, together with an identifier, for a post office box

classes.name: postcode
classes.label: postcode
classes.definition: sequence of characters used to assist in the sorting of mail

classes.name: postdirectional symbol
classes.label: postdirectional symbol
classes.definition: geographic directional symbol that follows the street name and street suffix in a street address

classes.name: predirectional symbol
classes.label: predirectional symbol
classes.definition: geographic directional symbol that occurs after the primary street number but before the street name in a street address

classes.name: primary address number
classes.label: primary address number
classes.definition: address component that identifies a location with respect to a given street

classes.name: region-specific identifier
classes.label: region-specific identifier
classes.definition: geographic region or subdivision identifier used internally by a country or other region

classes.name: secondary unit
classes.label: secondary unit
classes.definition: address component that identifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address

classes.name: secondary unit designator
classes.label: secondary unit designator
classes.definition: classifier for a smaller structure or component within a larger facility, such as an apartment, office, mail stop, or other similar designation

classes.name: secondary unit indicator
classes.label: secondary unit indicator
classes.definition: index to the specific unit within a secondary unit, such as a building or apartment, at a particular street address

classes.name: street address
classes.label: street address
classes.definition: index to a location that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit

classes.name: street name
classes.label: street name
classes.definition: identifier for a street in some context (e.g., city, municipality, geographic region)

classes.name: street suffix
classes.label: street suffix
classes.definition: classifier for a street or other delivery location, such as a dwelling located along a waterway

classes.name: structure name
classes.label: structure name
classes.definition: name for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures

classes.name: supplemental address component
classes.label: supplemental address component
classes.definition: address component that provides additional information that is important to ensuring proper delivery of communications

classes.name: supplemental address designator
classes.label: supplemental address designator
classes.definition: classifier for supplemental address information, such as a highway contract route, rural route, building complex, shopping center, condominium complex, mail box, or other similar designation

classes.name: supplemental address unit
classes.label: supplemental address unit
classes.definition: address component that includes a specific route, box, apartment, condominium or other indicator or unit associated with a specific address

classes.name: virtual address
classes.label: virtual address
classes.definition: address identifying a virtual, i.e. non-physical, location

classes.name: personal property
classes.label: personal property
classes.definition: asset that is a movable item or possession not fixed to land

classes.name: property inspection
classes.label: property inspection
classes.definition: event that involves analyzing one or more aspects of a real property

classes.name: property inspection report
classes.label: property inspection report
classes.definition: report covering the findings of a property inspection

classes.name: real estate
classes.label: real estate
classes.definition: real property, interests in mortgages on real property (including interests in mortgages on leaseholds of land or improvements thereon), and shares in qualified real estate investment trusts

classes.name: real property
classes.label: real property
classes.definition: physical asset defined as land together with any structures that are permanently attached to that land, such as houses, trees, fences and improvements

classes.name: real property appraisal
classes.label: real property appraisal
classes.definition: value assessment that estimates the amount of money some real property is worth

classes.name: real property identifier
classes.label: real property identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier given to identify a specific real property in some jurisidiction

classes.name: electronic mail address
classes.label: electronic mail address
classes.definition: virtual address that defines an electronic messaging endpoint to which email messages can be delivered, typically via an Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) based communications system

classes.name: network location
classes.label: network location
classes.definition: a virtual location that may be identified by a network address (an identifier for a node or interface)

classes.name: notional place
classes.label: notional place
classes.definition: an abstract place; one of many commonly understood concepts such as domestic, Eurozone etc.

classes.name: telephone number
classes.label: telephone number
classes.definition: virtual address that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices or services for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks

classes.name: complete address
classes.label: complete address
classes.definition: delivery address that has all the address elements necessary to allow an exact match with the current Postal Service ZIP+4 and City State files to obtain the finest level of ZIP+4 and delivery point codes for the delivery address

classes.name: delivery address code set
classes.label: delivery address code set
classes.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

classes.name: delivery point code
classes.label: delivery point code
classes.definition: specific set of digits between 00 and 99 assigned to a delivery point

classes.name: delivery point code set
classes.label: delivery point code set
classes.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

classes.name: Department of State address
classes.label: Department of State address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, 'DPO' as the literal value for the city, and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

classes.name: Department of State unit component
classes.label: Department of State unit component
classes.definition: component of a Department of State address that includes 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier

classes.name: general delivery address
classes.label: general delivery address
classes.definition: delivery address that uses the words 'GENERAL DELIVERY', uppercase preferred, spelled out (no abbreviation), in place of a street address

classes.name: highway contract route
classes.label: highway contract route
classes.definition: highway contract route associated with an address

classes.name: highway contract address
classes.label: highway contract address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'HC', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

classes.name: international address
classes.label: international address
classes.definition: physical address that explicitly includes a country

classes.name: mailbox
classes.label: mailbox
classes.definition: mailbox, other than a U.S. Post Office box, associated with an address

classes.name: overseas military address
classes.label: overseas military address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses an abbreviation for the unit or command such as 'CMR', 'PSC', or 'UNIT', or 'HC', followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, either 'APO' or 'FPO' as the literal value for the city and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

classes.name: private mail box address
classes.label: private mail box address
classes.definition: delivery address provided by a commercial mail receiving company that includes a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'PMB' or the pound "#" symbol followed by the mailbox number; alternatively, 'PMB' or '#" and the mailbox number can be appended to the street address

classes.name: Puerto Rico address
classes.label: Puerto Rico address
classes.definition: delivery address for a delivery point in Puerto Rico that may include a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'URB' followed by the name of the urbanization area that is appropriate for that address

classes.name: highway contract route address
classes.label: highway contract route address
classes.definition: mail route outside the city or township limits in a rural area associated with an address

classes.name: rural route address
classes.label: rural route address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'RR', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

classes.name: standardized address
classes.label: standardized address
classes.definition: delivery address that is fully spelled out, abbreviated by using the Postal Service standard abbreviations or as given in the current Postal Service ZIP+4 file

classes.name: U.S. Postal Service address identifier
classes.label: U.S. Postal Service address identifier
classes.definition: combined with the ZIP + 4 code, the delivery point code provides a unique identifier for every deliverable address served by the USPS

classes.name: urbanization
classes.label: urbanization
classes.definition: an area, sector, or development within a larger geographic area

classes.name: Zip Code
classes.label: Zip Code
classes.definition: five-digit code code assigned to a delivery address indicating the state and post office or postal zone

classes.name: ZIP+4 Code
classes.label: ZIP+4 Code
classes.definition: nine-digit number consisting of five digits, a hyphen, and four digits, which the USPS describes by its trademark ZIP+4

classes.name: zip code scheme
classes.label: zip code scheme
classes.definition: system used in the U.S. to facilitate the delivery of mail, consisting of a five- or nine-digit code Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) printed directly after the address, the first five digits (initial code) indicating the state and post office or postal zone, the last four (expanded code) the box section or number, portion of a rural route, building, or other specific delivery location

edges.name: has address
edges.label: has address
edges.definition: indicates a means by which something (in the case of a network address) or some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence

edges.name: has individual postcode
edges.label: has individual postcode
edges.definition: indicates the local or international postcode element of a delivery address as specified by the local postal service

edges.name: has postdirectional symbol
edges.label: has postdirectional symbol
edges.definition: specifies a geographic directional symbol that follows the street name and street suffix in a street address

edges.name: has predirectional symbol
edges.label: has predirectional symbol
edges.definition: specifies a geographic directional symbol that occurs after the primary street number but before the street name in a street address

edges.name: has primary address number
edges.label: has primary address number
edges.definition: specifies a a location with respect to a given street

edges.name: has secondary unit
edges.label: has secondary unit
edges.definition: specifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address

edges.name: has street address
edges.label: has street address
edges.definition: indicates a fully-specified address component that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit

edges.name: has street name
edges.label: has street name
edges.definition: specifies an identifier for a street in some context (e.g., 'Baker', 'First', 'Main')

edges.name: has street suffix
edges.label: has street suffix
edges.definition: specifies an additional qualifier for a street or other delivery location, such as a dwelling located along a waterway

edges.name: has structure name
edges.label: has structure name
edges.definition: specifies an identifier for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures

edges.name: has transliterated address
edges.label: has transliterated address
edges.definition: identifies a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) address for the registered entity

edges.name: has electronic mail address
edges.label: has electronic mail address
edges.definition: specifies an electronic messaging endpoint at which some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence

edges.name: has telephone number
edges.label: has telephone number
edges.definition: indicates a virtual address composed of a sequence of digits and symbols that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station, a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or other similar device or service

edges.name: has urbanization
edges.label: has urbanization
edges.definition: indicates area, sector, or development within a geographic area relevant to a delivery address

attributes.name: has address line 1
attributes.label: has address line 1
attributes.definition: the first line of the street address

attributes.name: has address line 2
attributes.label: has address line 2
attributes.definition: the second line of the street address

attributes.name: has address line 3
attributes.label: has address line 3
attributes.definition: the third line of the street address

attributes.name: has attention line
attributes.label: has attention line
attributes.definition: an optional, free text address line denoting the intended recipient

attributes.name: has mail routing
attributes.label: has mail routing
attributes.definition: an optional, free text address line containing explicit routing information (this elements's presence indicates that this address is a routing / 'care of' address)

attributes.name: has postal code
attributes.label: has postal code
attributes.definition: the postal code of this address as specified by the local postal service

attributes.name: requires secondary unit range
attributes.label: requires secondary unit range
attributes.definition: if true, indicates that an additional qualifier is needed to complete the delivery point description, such as an apartment number
